description: The pair of maximal-terminator-tested-fails where the longer y → A B has the tag p too. The test holds of it, so the omission of [T] after y → A is forbidden, and begins of r is false (engine §4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A B
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y⊇~p [++T] B
%rule y A <~p> | A B <~p>
